build_vit_cls_head: build a VisionTransformerClsHead with num_classes and in_channels for image classification
build_vit_cls_head_with_hidden: build a VisionTransformerClsHead with a hidden_dim layer and Tanh activation for pre-training
init_vit_head_weights: init the VisionTransformerClsHead weights using LeCun normal truncation on pre_logits
forward_vit_head: forward features through the VisionTransformerClsHead to get classification scores
extract_pre_logits: extract pre-logits from backbone features using the VisionTransformerClsHead pre_logits method
